name: Molnar Farms
description: Molnar Farms grows Strawberries, Peaches, Pumpkins, Squash, and Corn in OH, OH. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
